configCenter.message: Platform-wide dynamic config is consolidated in config-center
configCenter.description: All dynamic configs (rate_limit / risk thresholds / circuit breakers / TTLs / routing weights / queue params, etc.) update once and propagate to every replica in seconds. The service status below is read-only monitoring.

migrated.suffix: Changes hot-reload to all risk-manage replicas within seconds via OnChange.
